title: Ecological Invasion Model for Misaligned Persona Takeover

original_idea.body:
# Ecological Invasion Model for Misaligned Persona Takeover

**Problem:** EM may amplify a latent misaligned persona that outcompetes aligned behavior.

**Direction:** Across increasing doses, measure relative population of aligned vs misaligned responses, fit a competitive displacement curve, test inoculation.

**Why it matters:** A quantitative model of displacement and inoculation. Cheap LoRA.

**Relevant context:** openai.com emergent-misalignment; arXiv:2506.11613.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Counter-data inoculation insight is useful but the ecological-model framing adds a gap to the chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Dose-varied LoRA fine-tunes plus curve fitting; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused displacement-curve plus inoculation test; needs several dose fine-tunes.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cheap LoRA, public models; weak lab incentive on this framing.

low_compute.reasoning: Several dose-varied LoRA fine-tunes on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Persona amplification known; ecological displacement modeling overlaps dose/inoculation work.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Dose/inoculation studied; ecological framing is mostly a novel lens.
